text:
The Flyers need more from Travis Konecny, and he knows it. After Sunday's 5-2 loss to Edmonton, a game in which, as PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor noted, his turnover led to the Oilers' fourth goal, Konecny said: "I mean, I don't know how many looks I had. Way too many to not put one in." O'Connor's read was blunt: he's "pretty clearly pressing." Earlier in the week, a clip of him calling out Matvei Michkov on the bench made the rounds.

The scoring is thin: 2 goals and 6 points in 13 games, 1.61 points per hour against 2.78 last season. Our numbers say a lot of that is bad luck around him. His teammates have scored 5.5 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on, he's shooting 7.1% against a league norm of 13.3%, and his own chance rate (0.91 expected goals per hour) is right where it was last season.

The five on five play has been decent too: Philadelphia's expected goals share is 5.98 points better with him on than off. The process isn't broken. Watch whether he can stop squeezing the stick long enough for the bounces to turn.
headline: Travis Konecny is pressing
